## 1. BAR rule (vsess_50, run-merged _CANC), every constant
Code: kernel `outputs/code/th_bars/kernels.py` k_cum lines 10-31 (mode 0, metric = size); thresholds `outputs/code/th_bars/build_month.py` scales() lines 13-32 and line 96 (`np.maximum(svol/p,1.0)`, p = 50); sessions `common.py` lines 10-17 (ET: code 0 Asia 18:00-02:00, 1 London 02:00-08:30, 2 pre 08:30-09:30, 3 NY AM 09:30-12:00, 4 NY PM 12:00-16:00, 5 close 16:00-18:00; td = ET + 6 h; session id td x 10 + code).
1. PRINT STREAM = run-merged prints (D8_PRINT_RULE.md sections 1 and 4, `_CANC`): record side = BUY if last >= ask, else SELL if last <= bid, else 0; consecutive records with the same price and side form ONE print (volume summed, no time condition, never across a session boundary or contract change); the merged print is stamped with the time the run is KNOWN complete = the timestamp of the next print with a different price or side (last run of a session: its own last record). Boundaries identical to the NT8 export on 20261110 NY AM (208,040 prints, 100.000%).
2. KERNEL k_cum: per session key and instrument id; a bar opens at the first print after the previous close (or the session's first print); every print is added WHOLE (volume, high, low, close); then `cum >= thr` (greater-or-equal) closes the bar with that print; the closing print stays in the bar; cum resets to 0 at the next bar. Known time = stamp of the closing print. At a change of key or instrument the open bar is emitted with part = 1 (known at its last print); bar index restarts at 0.
3. THRESHOLD thr = max(sess_vol[4] / 50, 1.0) contracts for every print of NY PM of that td, fixed for the whole session. sess_vol[code][td] = median of the previous up to 20 values of that code's session volume (the 20 stats_day ROWS before the td; the current session not used; values <= 0 or missing dropped; >= 5 needed else back/forward fill) (build_month.py lines 23-31). Session volume = sum of `sz` of every trade record of that code of the td, all instrument ids.
4. Thresholds used by the engine (A = engine store as it is): td 20261027: code 0 1,245.99 / 1 1,265.03 / 2 426.60 / 3 4,872.64 / **4 3,744.58** / 5 310.92; td 20261110: 0 1,704.24 / 1 1,394.68 / 2 493.66 / 3 5,265.95 / **4 4,255.57** / 5 369.39. The trigger runs on the continuous series of ALL session codes (section 2), so all six are listed; the 45-day tables are in section 4.
5. Checks on the stored NY PM bars: td 20261027: 45 closed bars of 3,745-3,754 contracts + 1 truncated bar (part = 1) of 1,857 = 170,437 = the session total; td 20261110: 45 closed bars of 4,256-4,349 + 1 truncated of 1,215 = 192,870 = the session total. Overshoot = the merged print that closes the bar.
6. First bar starts at the first merged print of the session (t0 stored 16:00:00.012Z on 20261027, 17:00:00.008Z on 20261110; stamp rule of item 1). 46 bars per NY PM on both parity days (45 + 1 truncated); the count varies with volume vs the median. The truncated last bar (part = 1) is never a signal bar.

## 2. TRIGGER rule (every constant)
Code: `outputs/code/th_grid/trig_manual_macd.py` (shim) -> `outputs/code/th_grid/triggers_b/registry.py` line 62 (family manual, name macd), `impl_um.py` lines 34-52 (`macd_parts`, `macd_sig`), `core.py` lines 13-43 (`prep`: roll adjustment), 56-61 (`out`), 63-69 (`edge`), 80-84 (`ema`). Variant `sigcross` (plain, not native), f = 12, s = 26, g = 9. Input line: bar CLOSE in points of the book's own vsess_50 bars of ALL sessions, in known-time order, one continuous series since 2023-04-02 (D8_BAR_DEFS.md section 2).
1. ROLL ADJUSTMENT (core.prep lines 31-37): where the instrument id of consecutive bars changes (14 rolls in the history, taken from the real roll table below), every OLDER bar's prices are shifted by (open of the first bar after the roll - close of the last bar before it), cumulatively; later bars stay raw. The MACD therefore sees a gap-free series; at a live roll the NT8 series must be back-adjusted the same way (or the first ~100 bars after a roll will differ). The last roll before the parity days is 2026-09-16 (no adjustment on 20261027 or 20261110: the INPUTS closes are raw).
2. ema12 = EMA(close, 12), ema26 = EMA(close, 26), macd = ema12 - ema26, signal = EMA(macd, 9). EMA: alpha = 2/(n+1); value_0 = first value of the series (no SMA seed); value_j = alpha x x_j + (1 - alpha) x value_{j-1} (core.ema lines 80-84). The signal EMA is seeded with the first macd (= 0).
3. State: above = macd > signal (strict), below = macd < signal (strict). EVENT (edge): LONG at bar j when above_j and not above_{j-1}; SHORT when below_j and not below_{j-1} (a bar that is both is ignored; previous-bar flags are False for bar 0). This includes a bar where macd equals the signal on the previous bar followed by above. Computed at the bar close.
4. Warm-up: signals before bar index s + g = 35 of the series are zeroed; bar 0 never signals; part = 1 bars never signal (`out`, line 58). Irrelevant live (history since 2023).
5. Only signals on bars with session code 4 and part == 0 are used (section 3). All six session codes' bars are in the series, each built with its own session's threshold.
6. Warm-up for a coder: seed ema12, ema26 and signal with the full-precision values printed in the first INPUTS row of each day (they are the engine's values, roll-adjusted), then continue bar by bar through all sessions. A restart per session would give different crossing bars.
Real roll table used by the engine (iid assignment by searchsorted on ts; step = price step in points of the roll; /mnt/l2/l2vast/_bars/feat_d/nq_rolls.csv):

## 3. From signal to order, sides, bracket, one position
Engine path: `th_nyeng/ny_build.py` events() lines 25-37 (the CANC events, built via th_d8spec/bulk_fl.py with bars redirected to bars_c) and the bracket rebuild `th_brkt/brkt_build.py` build_from_file lines 88-98: keep a signal only if the bar has part == 0 and session code == 4; order time ts = floor(bar known time to whole seconds) + 2 s; exit_ts = 16:00 ET (end of the signal bar's ET session; `th_swap/common.py` sess_end_ns lines 32-40); events with ts >= exit_ts dropped (a signal on a bar known after 15:59:58 ET never trades); exit capped by cap_exit (if no print within 120 s after the scheduled exit, the exit is the last print before it; 7 of 3,690 events have a capped exit). Both sides kept. Bracket SHAPES F90_30 (brkt_build.py line 19): STOP 90.0 points, TARGET 30.0 points, from the fill, fixed, 1 lot (1 point = 4 ticks = $20: stop 360 ticks = $1,800, target 120 ticks = $600 per contract). Verified: independent re-implementation of the pipeline gives 3,690 events, time and side identical to the stored file (and the 16 additional signals of the series on bars known at 15:59:59 ET are correctly dropped).
ONE POSITION per book: an event while in a trade / exit pending / entry in flight is dropped (D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2)); the events file is not a trade list. Seen: 20261027 has 3 events and 3 trades (each exited before the next order); 20261110 has 5 events (one trade cannot be shown: month not landed).
Session window: NY PM bars (12:00-16:00 ET), flat at 16:00 ET (UWTime +1.0 s). Entry/fill/exit mechanics as in D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2), quoted not re-derived: market order at ts, fill +1.0 s walking the 10-level book, stop order at fill -/+ 90, target limit at fill +/- 30. Consistency on 20261027: entries = order times + 1.000 s; targets filled at exactly +30.00; the third trade ran to the session end (UWTime exit 20:00:01.000Z, -3.0 points).

## 5. Parity data, td 20261027 (EDT, NY PM 16:00-20:00Z) and td 20261110 (EST, NY PM 17:00-21:00Z)
BARS = the 46 NY PM bars of `/mnt/l2/l2vast/_d8spec/bars_c/vsess_50/202610.parquet`, `202611.parquet` (last row part = 1; volume = contracts of merged prints). SIGNALS = the stored events rows of that td (order time = known time floored + 2 s). INPUTS = the 60 bars before the NY PM open (all sessions, roll-adjusted closes = raw here) and the 46 NY PM bars with ema12, ema26, macd, signal, hist (points) and the crossing flags (flags are the raw trigger output; only NY PM flags with part 0 become events). TRADES = engine bare 1-lot run, base set `TL3_ALN_NP_L6d238076_R0BRF90_30`.
